hooks.command: D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -n "$D" ] && cd "$D" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -d memory ] || exit 0; INPUT=$(cat); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null); else TOOL=unknown; FILE=unknown; fi; REL="${FILE#"$D"/}"; printf '[%s] %s %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')" "$TOOL" "$REL" >> memory/activity.log 2>/dev/null; exit 0
